subject: MAP: 90-day pilot, credit bridge, and conversion terms
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@olivetech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP proposal: 90-day pilot + conversion framework

Jamie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I’m attaching a short mutual action plan (attached: MAP_OliveTech_Q1_v2.xlsx) that outlines a 90-day evaluation focused on three milestones: onboarding & integration (week 0–2), performance verification (week 3–6 — latency & accuracy SLAs), and ramp validation (week 7–12 — 10–20k inference calls/day).

Key commercial items in the MAP:
- Pilot credits: 100k token-equivalent credits applied to the pilot environment.
- Credit bridge: if you need an additional 30 days to complete ramp validation, we can grant a "credit bridge" of up to 40k tokens.
- Conversion pricing: e.g., 3-tier schedule depending on committed monthly tokens:
  - Tier A (>= 1M/mo): $0.007/token
  - Tier B (250k–1M/mo): $0.010/token
  - Tier C (<250k/mo): $0.015/token
  - First-quarter ramp discount: additional 15% on Tier A/B for the first 3 months after conversion if you hit agreed ramp milestones.
- Commitment term: 12 months minimum for the committed tier to receive discounts.

We can be flexible on the bridge credits and timing — I want to make sure you can finish the integration tests without breaking the evaluation. If acceptable, next steps would be:
1) You confirm the milestones and whether you need the 30-day bridge.
2) We finalize the SOW (I’ll draft and loop in Legal).
3) DocuSign for pilot SOW + credit application.

Attaching MAP and a draft SOW stub. Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week to walk through.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: MAP_OliveTech_Q1_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_OliveTech_Pilot.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@olivetech.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: 90-day pilot + conversion framework

Avery —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear milestone breakdown. The team has reviewed and a couple quick asks before we move to SOW:

1) We’re concerned the 100k pilot credits will fall short if we run throughput tests across three environments. Can OliveTech get an additional 50k as a one-time top-up if we hit the integration milestone?
2) Procurement will likely push back on a 12-month minimum commitment at Tier A pricing. Would Redwood consider a 6-month initial commitment with an option to extend to 12 months after the first quarter?
3) Can we get the credit bridge (the extra 30 days) as a formal approval path (i.e., automatic upon completion of integration milestone) rather than an ad hoc request?

If we can get those three items clarified, I think it removes blockers on our side. I’m copying procurement to keep them in the loop.

—Jamie
Jamie Park
Head of ML Platforms | OliveTech
jamie.park@olivetech.com

Jamie —

Thanks for the thoughtful notes. I’m stepping in to confirm commercial flexibility so we don’t lose momentum. Below are the replies to your three asks: 

1) Pilot top-up: We can approve a one-time top-up of 50k token-equivalent credits, contingent on you signing the MAP and completing the integration milestone (defined in the attached MAP sheet). We’ll apply the top-up automatically on successful integration test results.

2) Commitment term: We can offer a 6-month initial committed plan at Tier B pricing with a documented conversion path to a 12-month Tier A commitment after the first quarter. To qualify for the Tier A ramp discount (15%), OliveTech must reach the agreed ramp metric (>= 600k tokens/month) within the first 90 days after conversion. 

3) Credit bridge process: We will make the 30-day credit bridge policy explicit in the SOW: once integration milestone is validated (sign-off by OliveTech and Redwood), the bridge is automatically applied; no additional approvals required.

Action items:
- Avery to update SOW and add the explicit credit-bridge clause and the one-time top-up in the MAP.
- Jamie to confirm internal approval from procurement for the 6-month plan (we know procurement may ask for PO-first flow).

If procurement needs a worksheet with cost projection at the new terms, Neha can run a basic ramp-cost analysis.

Best,
Marissa Cole
